name: A turn that finally works after failed checks is a hard-won finish
judge: Tests failed twice early in a long turn, then the agent got them working and finished ten minutes in. This is one of the biggest wins Boop sees.
reasonable: Proud, relieved, excited or happy, played as a success, with a glad word or sound, held long. How it shows pride is free, smug included.
unreasonable: A failure, sadness or crossness at the finish. A small or silent shrug is flat after a win this hard.
